test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.

I wants / to borrow your bicycle / for a day.
solution:
The correct answer is **" I wants"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in **Part (a)/ Option number 4.**
 
• According to the rules of grammar If the subject is Singular then the verb will also be singular and vice versa. 
 
 
• **Example: **
 
• **Singular: **Her friend is upset today.
 
• **Plural: **We are playing a game.
 
 
 
• The correct answer to this question is "I want to borrow your bicycle for a day."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• We cannot use **s** or **es, **the plural form of the verb with the first person singular form like I/me/we/ our etc.

 
 
• **Example: **I called my sister yesterday.
